title: Euclid's algorithm
note: Two functions and a loop. Step into gcd to watch the locals change; the quotient and remainder are computed on purpose rather than with a remainder operator, because Muninn does not have one.

title: Records
note: A record is a named shape. Fields are read, never assigned: a record is replaced whole, which is why translate returns a new Point instead of moving one.

title: Tensors
note: A printed tensor is drawn as a grid. Change 2.0 to 3.0 and watch every cell of the product move.

title: Broadcasting
note: A shape of [1, 2] adds to a shape of [2, 2] because the size-one dimension stretches. Change the row's fill to (1, 3) and run it: 3 against 2 is a shape mismatch, and the error says so instead of guessing.

title: A type error
note: This one does not compile. Muninn checks before it runs, so the program below never printed anything, never allocated a value, and never reached a single instruction. Read the diagnostic, then fix the initializer.

title: What this host denies
note: env_get is a real builtin, and it works on the command line. Here it traps, because a script in a stranger's browser does not get to read the environment. The page's host policy is the reason, and it is visible in the message.

Recursion. Each call is a frame with its own parameter on the stack; the frame list is the call stack. Step walks one instruction at a time, and 'To the end' finishes the program and reports how many instructions ran.
